about: Chinook workload for tools/sample_db_bench.py. Chinook ships no views; origin 'upstream-test': the two non-trivial queries of upstream's test fixture (ChinookDatabase.Test/DatabaseTests/ChinookSqliteFixture.cs at the pinned commit), adapted as 'adaptation' says, with the result upstream asserts in 'expect'; 'authored': written for this eval.

queries.sql: SELECT count(InvoiceId) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceId NOT IN (SELECT InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId)

queries.adaptation: [name] quoting dropped; upstream asserts CalculatedTotal = Total on every row (checked as an assertion)
queries.sql: SELECT Invoice.InvoiceId, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS CalculatedTotal, Invoice.Total AS Total FROM InvoiceLine INNER JOIN Invoice ON InvoiceLine.InvoiceId = Invoice.InvoiceId GROUP BY Invoice.InvoiceId, Invoice.Total

SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name AS track, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist
FROM Track AS t
JOIN Album AS al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist AS ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE t.GenreId = 1

SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
FROM Artist AS ar
LEFT JOIN Album AS al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE al.AlbumId IS NULL

SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.LastName, m.LastName AS manager
FROM Employee AS e
LEFT JOIN Employee AS m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId

SELECT BillingCountry, COUNT(*) AS invoices, SUM(Total) AS revenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY BillingCountry
HAVING SUM(Total) > 50

SELECT g.Name AS genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT il.InvoiceId) AS invoices
FROM InvoiceLine AS il
JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.Name

SELECT DISTINCT c.Country
FROM Customer AS c
JOIN Employee AS e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
WHERE e.City = 'Calgary'

SELECT DISTINCT TrackId, Name
FROM Track
WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

SELECT TrackId, Name
FROM Track
WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

SELECT c.CustomerId, c.LastName
FROM Customer AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND t.GenreId = 2
)

SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds
FROM Track
WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track) AND GenreId = 3

SELECT al.AlbumId, al.Title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track AS t WHERE t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId) AS tracks
FROM Album AS al
WHERE al.ArtistId < 20

SELECT City, Country FROM Customer
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT City, Country FROM Employee

SELECT Country FROM Customer
INTERSECT DISTINCT
SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice

SELECT GenreId FROM Genre
EXCEPT DISTINCT
SELECT t.GenreId FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId

SELECT CustomerId, InvoiceId, InvoiceDate, Total,
  SUM(Total) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InvoiceDate, InvoiceId) AS running
FROM Invoice

SELECT AlbumId, TrackId, Milliseconds,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY AlbumId ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC) AS rnk
FROM Track
WHERE AlbumId <= 10

SELECT InvoiceId, CustomerId, Total,
  LAG(Total) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InvoiceDate, InvoiceId) AS previous
FROM Invoice

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT il.TrackId, SUM(il.Quantity) AS sold
  FROM InvoiceLine AS il
  GROUP BY il.TrackId
),
unused AS (
  SELECT 1 AS x
)
SELECT t.Name, s.sold
FROM Track AS t
JOIN sales AS s ON s.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE s.sold > 1

SELECT x.Country, x.n
FROM (SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY Country) AS x
WHERE x.n >= 2

SELECT COALESCE(a.GenreId, b.GenreId) AS GenreId, a.tracks, b.sold
FROM (SELECT GenreId, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId) AS a
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT t.GenreId, SUM(il.Quantity) AS sold
  FROM InvoiceLine AS il
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY t.GenreId
) AS b ON a.GenreId = b.GenreId

SELECT c.CustomerId, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS invoices
FROM Customer AS c
LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND i.InvoiceDate >= DATETIME '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId

SELECT CASE WHEN Milliseconds < 180000 THEN 'short' WHEN Milliseconds < 360000 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS length_class,
  COUNT(*) AS tracks, AVG(UnitPrice) AS price
FROM Track
GROUP BY length_class

SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name
FROM Playlist AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId)

SELECT CustomerId
FROM Customer
WHERE Company NOT IN (SELECT Company FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil')

SELECT ar.Name, totals.revenue
FROM Artist AS ar
JOIN (
  SELECT al.ArtistId, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue
  FROM InvoiceLine AS il
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Album AS al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  GROUP BY al.ArtistId
) AS totals ON totals.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE totals.revenue > 20

SELECT ((COUNT(DISTINCT (BillingCity)))) AS cities
FROM Invoice
WHERE (BillingCountry = 'USA')
